verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a mature REST API ecosystem (official SDKs, OAuth client, and a first-party MCP server with 145 tools covering full CRUD for 29 entity types plus 11 financial reports), indicating broad but not exhaustive UI-parity. However, probes show missing/undiscoverable openapi.json and llms.txt, and no evidence claims 100% feature parity with the UI (e.g. payroll, bank feed management, invoice customization workflows aren't confirmed as API-exposed). missing for 10: explicit vendor claim of full UI/API parity, independent confirmation that all major UI workflows (payroll, bank reconciliation, reporting customization) are API-accessible, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec.
